curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the nine-turn tear-off scene and exact 15-card source order: old roof, all layers including underlayment, flashing, pry bar, designated dumpster, and the foreman's two confirmation questions. Spanish source specifies asphalt shingles while English is generic; resolve material, structural deck, underlayment/felt and flashing senses with qualified Japanese/roofing reviewers. These commands describe this job's stated scope, not a universal tear-off method or approval to remove retained components. Archived Japanese and forms/speaking are evidence only; this packet creates no learner, audio, scoring or saved-progress identity.

cards.reviewNote: Spanish Tejas asfálticas specifies asphalt shingles; archived シングル材 is generic. Decide whether material specificity belongs in the Japanese face, Reader disposal line, dictionary and modes.
Deck is the structural roof deck at the tear-off endpoint; archived 屋根下地 could mean underlayment or general substrate. Choose a trade-precise term before scored commands.
Old roof in the source is broader than archived 既存の屋根 (existing roof). Confirm whether old/age and complete roof versus covering must be explicit.
Sub-capa / Fieltro may imply felt or underlayment, while archived ルーフィング can name roofing material more broadly. Resolve layer/material scope.
Tapajuntas / flashing is a broad component; archived 水切り板金 may narrow to edge flashing. Confirm the component before removal instruction.
